title: Important INC Sessions Extremist Phase
definition: The Indian National Congress sessions held during the Extremist Phase (1905–1917) marked a profound ideological shift from Moderate constitutional petitioning to Assertive Nationalism, witnessing intense intra-party friction, the historic Surat Split, and the eventual reunification at Lucknow.
importanceInUpsc: This topic is a high-yielding area for UPSC Prelims (chronology, presidents, venue locations, and outcomes) and provides core analytical content for GS-1 Modern Indian History regarding the evolution of nationalist strategies.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Important INC Sessions Extremist Phase.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
